title: Concerto
synopsis: A series of yuri one-shots. 1. Melody (旋律) A story about two childhood friends who like music and who are asked to perform at the graduation ceremony of their school. 2. Longing (あこがれ) Longing deals with two members of the archery club: Kyoko and her senpai Touko, who is ashamed of her man-like body. 3. Spice (スパイス) Spice is about a young girls-loving teacher who wants to seduce her female students. 4. Innocent (無垢) Innocent is about a nude portrait hanging in an art room, the model and the painter. 5. Rendez-vous (ランデブー) Rendez-vous is about two girls secretly in love who elope together after being found out.
